<Route path="/ade/dashboard/projects" />

A **project** is one API: its classes, paths and every version of it. **Go to Build → Projects** to
see them all. The header sums them up — for example *2 projects · avg quality 83 · 2 active*.

<Screenshot id="projects" alt="The Projects page in Cards view: two project cards with quality, lint and debt scores, a New project card and the portfolio quality trend" />

## Find a project

- **Search** with the filter box (<Kbd keys="/"/> focuses it).
- **Filter** with **All**, **Active**, **Needs attention** and **Deleted**. **Deleted** works once
  **Show deleted** is on.
- **Sort** with **Sorted by name ↑**.
- **Switch views** with **Cards** (the default) and **Table**.

<Screenshot id="projects-table" alt="The Projects page in Table view: columns for project, description, quality trend, versions, status and creator" />

The table shows **Project**, **Description**, **Quality trend**, **Versions**, **Status**, **Created
by** and **Updated**. **Portfolio quality trend** under the list plots average quality across
projects after each import.

**Click a project** to open its [versions](./versions.mdx).

## Create a project

1. **Click “New project”** (or press <Kbd keys="N"/>).
2. On **Create manually**, choose a **Starting template** — **Blank** starts empty.
3. Enter a **Project name** (for example `Payments API`); the **Slug** (`payments-api`) is suggested
   from it. **Description** and **Domain category** are optional.
4. Fill in **API metadata (OpenAPI info)** if you know it — **API summary**, contact and licence.
   It becomes the spec's `info` block, and you can change it later.
5. **Click “Create project”.**

<Screenshot id="projects-create-dialog" alt="The New project dialog: starting template, project name, slug, description and API metadata fields" />

**Design with AI** (marked *Beta*) drafts a project from a description instead. To start from a
file you already have, **click “Import”** — see [Import your first
project](../getting-started/first-project.mdx).

## Edit, delete and restore

Open a project's menu (**⋯** on a card or row):

| Item | Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Open versions** | Opens the project's [Versions](./versions.mdx) (table view) |
| **Consumers** | Who depends on this API — see below |
| **Edit project** | Changes the name, description and API metadata; **“Save changes”** |
| **Delete project** | Moves it to **Deleted**. Turn on **Show deleted** to find it again |
| **Undelete project** | Brings a deleted project back |
| **Permanently delete** | Removes it for good — type the slug, then **“Delete everything”** |

In the table, tick rows to **Delete** or **Undelete** several at once.

## Consumers

<Route path="/ade/dashboard/projects/[projectId]/consumers" />

**Consumers** lists the teams and services that depend on the API, and which operations and fields
each one uses. **“Register consumer”** adds one by hand; **“Import Pact file”** adds one from a
consumer contract.

## With the CLI or the API

- CLI: `apiome projects list`, `apiome projects get <id-or-slug>` — see the [CLI
  quick-start](../reference/cli-quickstart.md).
- REST: `GET` / `POST /v1/projects/{tenant}`, `GET` / `PUT` / `DELETE
  /v1/projects/{tenant}/{project}`, `POST /v1/projects/{tenant}/{project}/restore` — see the [API
  reference](../reference/api-reference.md).
